spec: Admit sprinkler requests with a requested duration in seconds only to the extent that accumulated actual commanded watering duration within the preceding rolling 48 hours stays at most 600 seconds; stop at the remaining quota. Durations and quota arithmetic belong to the automation. This revision implements the rolling budget at the original integer-second replay resolution; it does not delegate history or arithmetic to a backend.
source_text: My smart sprinkler should never be on more than 10 minutes every 2 days.
source_locator: Result sheet, Excel row 12, column BL (header 6_Q25, statement 6)
transcription: No action automatically changes fixture inputs. Initial inputs are sampled at t=0; rises are later events.

Every two days is a rolling 48-hour aggregate runtime limit, not one session per two days. Requests supply raw desired duration, not a precomputed quota. Empty prehistory. Requests do not overlap in these histories.
Supplemental tests use positive integer-second durations; zero/negative requests are ignored. Same-instant Off precedes new On. No pre-start watering or out-of-controller activation.
alternative_interpretation: Fixed calendar two-day budget, or one ten-minute session followed by a two-day cooldown.
favorable_bias: A bounded finite set of histories cannot establish arbitrary rolling-duration accounting.
stubs: ER24: raw typed inputs and observable leaf commands only
